title: Practice Makes Perfect: Tacit Knowledge, Generative AI, and Returns to Schooling and Experience
abstract: arXiv:2610.36008v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative AI changes the scarcity of different forms of human capital. It makes codified knowledge cheaply available at the point of production, while judgment acquired through practice remains tied more closely to the worker. We ask what this does to two familiar prices in the wage structure: the return to schooling and the return to experience. In a short-run framework, machine-supplied codified knowledge substitutes directly for the codified component of worker human capital, lowering the schooling gradient. If codified and practice-based knowledge are complements, the return to experience rises where learning through practice is fastest; technology-specific experience can also become obsolete, rotating the experience profile rather than shifting it uniformly. Using US Current Population Survey earnings data from 2018 through June 2026, we compare occupations in the top and bottom quartiles of the pre-ChatGPT Felten-Raj-Seamans expos

translated_title: 熟能生巧：隐性知识、生成式人工智能与教育和经验的回报
translated_abstract: 生成式人工智能改变了不同形式人力资本的稀缺性。它使编码化知识在生产现场能够以低成本获取，而通过实践积累的判断力仍然与劳动者自身紧密绑定。我们研究这对工资结构中两个熟悉的价格——教育回报率和经验回报率——会产生什么影响。在短期框架下，机器供给的编码化知识直接替代了工人人力资本中的编码化部分，从而降低了教育回报的梯度。如果编码化知识与基于实践的知识是互补的，那么在通过实践学习最快的领域，经验回报率将会上升；此外，特定技术的经验也可能过时，导致经验曲线发生旋转而非整体平移。利用2018年至2026年6月美国当期人口调查（CPS）的收入数据，我们比较了ChatGPT出现前Felten-Raj-Seamans AI暴露度指标最高与最低四分位数的职业……
tldr: 该论文提出生成式AI会降低教育回报率（因其替代编码化知识），同时提升实践经验回报率（因隐性知识仍需在实践中积累），从而重塑工资结构中的教育与经验溢价。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that generative AI lowers the return to schooling by substituting for codified knowledge while raising the return to experience where practice-based tacit learning matters most, reshaping the wage structure's schooling and experience premiums.
